description: Sanitized historical record of the Hindsight model-selection benchmarks run 2026-08-29 to 2026-08-30. Raw model responses, live memory text, generation IDs, hostnames, usernames, and infrastructure paths are excluded; only measured aggregates remain. The suite in this directory reproduces the methodology; re-running live suites will produce fresh numbers, not these.

environment.hindsight_deployment: self-hosted instance on a private network

live_telemetry_before_change.source: Hindsight llm-requests telemetry, agents bank, last 100 requests

retain_matrix_direct.method: Exact live Hindsight extraction system prompt (~3,300 input tokens), strict JSON schema, 3 runs per configuration, synthetic fixture content

results.label: glm-high
results.note: The one automated miss was a scoring artifact (model restated the superseded date with an explicit correction qualifier).

results.label: glm-none
results.error: HTTP 400: Reasoning is mandatory for this endpoint and cannot be disabled.
results.note: OpenRouter rejects effort=none for this model; low is the practical minimum.

results.label: gpt-oss-20b-low
results.note: Manual review: the automated miss was a scoring artifact; output preserved all material qualifiers.

results.label: gpt-oss-120b-low
results.note: Routing spread across three providers (Groq/Nebius/BaseTen) made latency inconsistent; ~2x output tokens.

results.label: gemini-2.5-flash-lite
results.note: Repeatedly omitted the recorded-call count and the API-key rule; weakened the undecided-retention and unproven-cause framing.

results.label: mistral-small-3.2
results.note: Run 3 returned a non-parseable response; slow through its available endpoint.

retain_adversarial_direct.method: Synthetic adversarial set covering negation, attribution, uncertainty, rejected suggestions, corrected dates, medical non-diagnosis qualifiers, unproven causality, temporary feedback, entity disambiguation, unverified third-party claims; 3 runs per model

results.label: gpt-oss-20b-low
results.note: Two automated flags: tesla_attribution was a scoring artifact (correctly split facts); causality flag was real but subtle - the model omitted the unproven-causation qualifier sentence entirely while never asserting causation. Historical manual review accepted the trade-off; the committed criteria count it as a miss.

results.label: gemini-2.5-flash-lite
results.note: Weakened qualifications and over-extracted (11 facts, several without their qualifiers).

long_journal.method: Synthetic 180,000-character journal (29,726 words) with 12 planted durable facts from beginning to end; chunked with the live Hindsight v0.9.2 chunker (docker exec) then each chunk extracted with openai/gpt-oss-20b:nitro, low reasoning, 8-way concurrency

extraction.coverage: 12/12 planted facts (automated string checks reported 9/12; manual review confirmed all 12 - the misses were date-normalization and fact-splitting artifacts)

boundary_behavior.method: Same fact pairs extracted combined versus as independent no-overlap chunks (Hindsight's plain-text chunker has no overlap)

findings.split: Two facts: the obsolete decision AND the correction, both persisted.
Both facts preserved, no false causal link, but the qualifier became a separate memory.

findings.combined: Claim attributed to Maya + unverified status preserved.
findings.split: 'Deployment completed by Maya' plus a second fact retaining the unresolved pronoun 'her claim'.

boundary_behavior.conclusion: Chunk-boundary context loss is the real long-document limitation, not model context size.

probes.facts_recovered: 4/5 planted needles; missed an end-of-context causal qualifier and part of one negation

probes.error: maximum context length is 131072 tokens; requested about 157012 (154012 text input + 3000 output)

context_limit_probes.conclusion: Extraction recall degrades before the hard context ceiling; the limit covers system prompt + input + reserved output.

recall_trace.note: Recall invokes no generative LLM; it makes one query-embedding call and one reranker call. Traced with budget=mid, max_tokens=1500, trace=true on the agents bank.

reranker_latency.method: 5 runs per model on the identical 300-document real candidate pool (direct OpenRouter /v1/rerank)

reranker_quality_clean.method: 6 labeled cases (current-vs-stale settings, paths, negation/attribution, unproven causality, corrected dates, current-vs-previous model), each padded to 300 documents with synthetic neutral distractors; 1 call per model per case
reranker_quality_clean.key_finding: On the unproven-causality case, rerank-4-fast ranked the explicit causal claim above documents saying causation was unproven; rerank-4-pro did not. All three models ranked a stale 'currently uses v3.5' statement top-1 on the current-reranker case: rerankers score relevance, not truth.
reranker_quality_clean.discarded_methodology: An earlier quality run padded pools with real memories from the live bank while assigning them grade 0; relevant-but-ungraded distractors invalidated the scores. It was replaced by the neutral-pool method above and must not be reintroduced.

candidate_caps_direct.note: Direct rerank calls on the first N documents of the same 300-document pool, 3 runs per cell
candidate_caps_direct.conclusion: Lowering HINDSIGHT_API_RERANKER_MAX_CANDIDATES from 300 to 100 saves ~0.45s and two-thirds of rerank cost, but bank-level quality at lower caps was not validated.

production_rollout.change: Retain-only model switch in the startup script: HINDSIGHT_API_RETAIN_LLM_MODEL=openai/gpt-oss-20b:nitro, HINDSIGHT_API_RETAIN_LLM_REASONING_EFFORT=low, HINDSIGHT_API_RETAIN_LLM_EXTRA_BODY={"provider":{"require_parameters":true}}
verification: Running-image source confirmed HINDSIGHT_API_RETAIN_LLM_REASONING_EFFORT exists and resolves before the global effort (memory_engine.py: retain_llm_reasoning_effort or llm_reasoning_effort)
Startup script executed; health returned healthy/database connected
Logs: retain initialized as openai/gpt-oss-20b:nitro reasoning_effort=low; reflect/consolidation remain z-ai/glm-5.3-flash reasoning_effort=high; OpenRouter connection verified
Dry-run extraction: 349-char adversarial sample 5/5 facts in 1.737s; 20,731-char multi-chunk sample recovered beginning/middle/end facts in 1.416s
Telemetry: GPT-OSS retain chunks 1.02-1.57s versus immediately preceding GLM retain calls 9.6-19.4s
production_rollout.notes: low reasoning still emits a small number of reasoning tokens (~10-190 per call); it reduces rather than disables reasoning. effort=none is rejected by the endpoint.

decisions.retain_model: openai/gpt-oss-20b:nitro with low reasoning (~9x faster than the live GLM baseline, half the per-call cost, passed the adversarial set with one documented qualifier-omission trade-off)
decisions.reranker: keep cohere/rerank-4-pro (best measured relevance; Fast saves only ~0.4s of a 3.85s recall and regressed on causality qualification)
decisions.candidate_cap: leave at 300 pending a quality-validated cap sweep
decisions.chunk_size: leave at 3000 chars; the long-document limitation is boundary context, not context size
